scripts.build: npm run build -w @invoice/shared && npm run build -w @invoice/api && npm run build -w @invoice/web
scripts.dev: npm run build -w @invoice/shared && concurrently -n api,web -c green,cyan "npm run dev -w @invoice/api" "npm run dev -w @invoice/web"
scripts.test: npm run build -w @invoice/shared && npm run test -w @invoice/shared && npm run test -w @invoice/api && npm run test -w @invoice/web
scripts.test:integration: npm run build -w @invoice/shared && npm run test:integration -w @invoice/api
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @invoice/shared && npm run typecheck -w @invoice/api && npm run typecheck -w @invoice/web
